acceptance: drop accepts a reason that is stored on the item in the same state commit as the status change
show_item and list rows for dropped items show the reason
The todo skill and get_instructions describe the reason field
context: Found while dropping superseded items during the site-split follow-ups batch on 2026-10-30.
description: The drop tool takes only the item id (and generation for a live claim), so the reason for a drop has to go in a separate update_item context_append first. That is two state commits per drop, the reason can be lost if the second write fails or is skipped, and nothing requires a reason at all. On 2026-10-30 four core items were dropped this way.
